falsifiable_hypothesis: The current B common theta-bias location uses gB^2*r_theta weights. Targets whose fitted theta correction has negligible magnitude contribute little correction energy even when their bias estimate is reliable. Multiplying by theta_full^2 makes the common-mode location emphasize targets with both reliable bias evidence and substantial active correction energy, while retaining the tuning-free weighted median for robustness.
gain_rule: Reproduce half_prior_negative_A_extension exactly: B uses the 1/K=1/3 active-raw shrink toward the reliability-weighted common gain, A uses the [-0.9375,+0.5] raw bound and all existing bounded-jackknife/global/vote rules unchanged.
theta_rule: Compute theta_full, theta_loo, bias_j=theta_full,j-theta_loo,j, jackknife variance v_j, and r_j=bias_j^2/(bias_j^2+v_j) exactly as in half_prior_negative_A_extension. Orientation A remains thetaA_j=theta_full,j+(1+r_j)*bias_j. For B define nonnegative correction-energy weights w_j=gB_j^2*theta_full,j^2*r_j. Define mu_B as the tuning-free weighted median of bias_j under w_j, with mu_B=0 only when total weight is zero. Deploy thetaB_j=theta_full,j+bias_j+mu_B+r_j*(bias_j-mu_B).
weight_rationale: gB^2*theta_full^2 is the squared magnitude factor of the fitted B correction channel, while r_j is the already-frozen fitting-only reliability of the finite-sample theta bias. No exponent menu, threshold, trim fraction, fold routing, target routing, or outer-held rescue is used. This remains repeated adaptive development because preceding outer outcomes were inspected.
